name: @selvajs/cli
description: Scaffold and operate a Selva white-label deployment. `npx @selvajs/cli <dir>` to bootstrap, `selva <cmd>` to manage.
author: VektorNode

scripts.test: node --check ./bin/cli.js && node --check ./bin/selva.js && node --input-type=module -e "for (const m of ['./src/cli.js','./src/prompts.js','./src/env.js','./src/paths.js','./src/secrets.js','./src/commands/create.js','./src/commands/init.js','./src/commands/doctor.js','./src/commands/pm2.js','./src/commands/migrate.js','./src/commands/keys.js']) { await import(m); }"
